data.name: Ilango
data.gender_notes: Ilango is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ilanga' meaning 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Ilango is a name of the Sun God, Surya. This name is believed to bring strength, vitality, and warmth to the bearer. The name Ilango carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ilango usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine light of consciousness.
data.etymology: Ilango belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilango total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ilango holds immense importance in the Hindu culture and is revered as an auspicious name. It is believed to bring blessings of the Sun God, Surya, who is the source of light, energy, and life. The name Ilango is also popular in Tamil literature, with the famous Tamil linguist and author, Ilango Adigal, bearing this name.
data.spiritual_significance: According to Hindu spiritual belief, the name Ilango signifies a deep connection with the Sun God, Surya. It is believed that the vibrations of the name Ilango purify the mind and instill a sense of positivity, strength, and vitality. Moreover, the name Ilango is considered to be a symbol of love, light, and knowledge, representing the Sun's radiance and enlightening power.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ilango, derived from the Tamil word 'Ilam' (tree) and 'Ango' (sacred grove), symbolizes the connection between an individual and nature. It signifies a deep reverence for the natural world and the belief that all life is intertwined in a divine dance.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ilango was a renowned Tamil poet and sage in ancient India. The name Ilango carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ilango is considered one of the greatest Tamil poets and sages in ancient India. He is known for his works in the Tamil language, particularly in the Agam literature.
